answer_1.quote: Every question-answer pair in QReCC is also annotated with a question rewrite. ... a model is trained to generate a stand-alone question given a follow-up question and the preceding question-answer pairs.

answer_2.quote: We use several automated metrics to compare the rewrites with the ground truth and compute their Pearson correlation with the human judgements ... ROUGE ... USE ... R@10 ... METEOR ... BLEU ... Exact Match ... Embedding-based metrics.

answer_4.quote: A random sample of 10K questions ... different annotators graded each model-generated rewrite with a binary label: 0 (incorrect rewrite) or 1 (correct rewrite).
